shots.scene: 欣欣举着一个贴有危险象形图标签的试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a closed reagent bottle with a blank label showing hazard pictograms in red diamonds.
shots.narration: 这一课讲美国的危害告知标准。
overlay: 化学品危害告知：一书一签

shots.scene: 一本空白说明书和一张空白标签并排
shots.prompt_en: A blank safety data sheet booklet and a blank chemical label with red diamond pictograms side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 核心就是标签和安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿起一个瓶子，看着标签上的菱形图案发愣
shots.prompt_en: The young male student picks up a reagent bottle and stares blankly at the red diamond pictograms on its label.
shots.narration: 阿杰看着标签上的红菱形，一头雾水。

shots.scene: 小研拿着说明书走过来
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over holding a blank safety data sheet booklet.
shots.narration: 小研说：先弄懂危害告知是怎么回事。

shots.section_title: 安全意识，从危害告知开始
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验室里，身旁浮现美国职业安全卫生管理局的盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in a lab beside a floating blank shield emblem icon.
shots.narration: 一切从了解危害告知标准开始。
overlay: 安全意识，从危害告知开始

shots.section_title: 安全意识，从危害告知开始
shots.scene: 两个人之间有一个对话气泡，里面是警示三角
shots.prompt_en: Two simple person icons with a speech bubble between them containing a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 没有沟通，就谈不上安全意识。

shots.section_title: 接触的人都要知道三件事
shots.scene: 欣欣伸出三根手指，旁边浮现三张卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up three fingers beside three floating blank cards.
shots.narration: 凡是可能接触的人，都要知道三件事。
overlay: 接触的人都要知道三件事

shots.section_title: 接触的人都要知道三件事
shots.scene: 学生、老师、清洁工的剪影都看向同一个试剂瓶
shots.prompt_en: Simple silhouettes of a cleaner, a student and a teacher all looking at the same labeled reagent bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 危险、正确处置、紧急情况下怎么做。

shots.section_title: 生产和进口商：先评估危害
shots.scene: 工厂图标旁有放大镜在检查化学品桶
shots.prompt_en: A factory icon with a magnifying glass examining a chemical drum. No people.
shots.narration: 按美国职业安全卫生管理局的规定，
overlay: 生产和进口商：先评估危害

shots.section_title: 生产和进口商：先评估危害
shots.scene: 化学品桶上逐一出现危险分类的图标
shots.prompt_en: A chemical drum with hazard class icons appearing one by one beside it: a flame, a skull and a corroded hand. No people.
shots.narration: 生产和进口商要评估化学品的危害。

shots.section_title: 生产和进口商：编好标签和说明书
shots.scene: 工厂图标送出说明书和标签，箭头指向下游客户
shots.prompt_en: A factory icon sending a blank data sheet booklet and a blank label along an arrow to a customer building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 还要编制标签和安全技术说明书，
overlay: 生产和进口商：编好标签和说明书

shots.section_title: 生产和进口商：编好标签和说明书
shots.scene: 试剂瓶随说明书一起到达实验室
shots.prompt_en: A delivered reagent box opened on a bench, a bottle with a pictogram label and a blank booklet inside. No people.
shots.narration: 把危害信息传给下游客户。

shots.section_title: 用人单位：标签和说明书交到手
shots.scene: 老周把说明书放进实验室文件架
shots.prompt_en: The older man places a blank safety data sheet booklet into a binder on the lab shelf.
shots.narration: 工作场所有危险化学品的雇主，
overlay: 用人单位：标签和说明书交到手

shots.section_title: 用人单位：标签和说明书交到手
shots.scene: 每个试剂瓶标签完好，旁边对应一份说明书
shots.prompt_en: A row of reagent bottles with intact pictogram labels, each matched to a blank booklet behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 要给接触的员工提供标签和说明书。

shots.section_title: 用人单位：提供充分培训
shots.scene: 王老师在培训室给学生上课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a group of workers in a training room in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 还要提供充分的培训，让大家会处置。
overlay: 用人单位：提供充分培训

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本区域危害和防护
shots.scene: 王老师指着平面图上的危险区域
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a simple work area floor map with hazard icons marking certain benches.
shots.narration: 培训要讲清所在工作区域的危害，
overlay: 培训讲清本区域危害和防护

shots.section_title: 培训讲清本区域危害和防护
shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、呼吸器三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: safety goggles, protective gloves and a respirator. No people.
shots.narration: 以及员工必须采取的自我防护措施。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一个空白浓度图表前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank chart with a rising concentration curve.
shots.narration: 再看几个基本术语。第一个：行动水平。

shots.scene: 图表上两条线，下面一条正好在上面一条的一半处
shots.prompt_en: A chart with an upper red limit line and a dashed line exactly halfway below it. No people.
shots.narration: 空气中浓度，通常是容许暴露限值的一半。

shots.scene: 八小时钟面和平均线图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock face icon showing an eight-hour span next to a flat average line. No people.
shots.narration: 按8小时时间加权平均来计算。

shots.scene: 曲线越过虚线，出现监测仪和体检图标
shots.prompt_en: A concentration curve crossing the dashed line, triggering a gas monitor icon and a medical checkup icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一到这个水平，就要开始监测和医学监护。

shots.scene: 一条粗红线，曲线碰到就被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A thick red horizontal line at the top of a chart; a curve touching it is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 上限值：员工接触永远不能超过它。

shots.scene: 测量仪读数旁有正负号的误差范围
shots.prompt_en: A blank measuring instrument display with a reading bar and a plus-minus range bracket around it. No people.
shots.narration: 采样与分析误差，

shots.scene: 统计分布曲线图标
shots.prompt_en: A bell-shaped statistical distribution curve icon with a marked center line. No people.
shots.narration: 是对测量结果不确定度的统计估计。

shots.scene: 短时间内曲线出现尖峰，旁边有小秒表
shots.prompt_en: A chart with a short sharp peak in the curve and a small stopwatch icon above the peak. No people.
shots.narration: 短时间接触限值，

shots.scene: 秒表上标出一小段时间
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon with a short highlighted segment of its dial. No people.
shots.narration: 是短时间内的平均接触浓度，

shots.scene: 欣欣举起秒表
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a stopwatch.
shots.narration: 这段时间通常是15到30分钟。

shots.scene: 一整天的曲线被拉平成一条平均线
shots.prompt_en: A full-day wavy curve with a flat average line drawn through it and a sun-to-moon workday icon. No people.
shots.narration: 时间加权平均，是一段时间的平均浓度，

shots.scene: 八小时钟面图标
shots.prompt_en: A clock face icon showing an eight-hour span. No people.
shots.narration: 这段时间通常是8小时。

shots.section_title: 可燃与易燃，行业标准有差别
shots.scene: 两个瓶子，一个标着小火苗，一个标着大火苗
shots.prompt_en: Two closed bottles side by side, one with a small flame icon and one with a big flame icon. No people.
shots.narration: 各行业常用两个术语：可燃和易燃液体。
overlay: 可燃与易燃，行业标准有差别

shots.section_title: 可燃与易燃，行业标准有差别
shots.scene: 实验室和建筑工地两个图标，中间有不等号
shots.prompt_en: Two icons, a laboratory and a construction site, with a not-equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 要注意，建筑工地的标准可能不一样。

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 温度计上标出一条刻度线，上方是小火苗瓶
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon with one marked line; a bottle with a small flame sits above the line. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点在100华氏度及以上，是可燃液体。
overlay: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 温度计刻度线下方是大火苗瓶
shots.prompt_en: The same thermometer icon; a bottle with a big flame sits below the marked line. No people.
shots.narration: 闪点低于100华氏度，是易燃液体。

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 一个混合物烧杯，大部分体积标成高闪点组分
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of a liquid mixture with a large portion of its volume shaded in one color and a thin layer in another. No people.
shots.narration: 但高闪点组分占混合物体积99%以上，

shots.section_title: 按闪点区分可燃与易燃
shots.scene: 混合物烧杯被移出易燃液体一栏
shots.prompt_en: The mixture beaker icon moved out of a flammable column with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 这种混合物不算易燃液体。

shots.scene: 一把大伞下罩着很多危险图标
shots.prompt_en: A big umbrella icon covering many small hazard icons underneath. No people.
shots.narration: 你会发现，易燃常被当成笼统说法，

shots.scene: 欣欣张开双臂，身旁浮现多种火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot spreads its arms wide beside many different flame icons.
shots.narration: 涵盖的风险范围非常广。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现说明书和标签
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a floating blank data sheet booklet and a blank pictogram label.
shots.narration: 标签和说明书，把危害信息传到人手上。

shots.scene: 工厂、雇主、员工三个图标串成链
shots.prompt_en: Three icons linked in a chain: a factory, an employer building and a worker with goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 评估、告知、培训，一环都不能少。

shots.scene: 五个术语卡片排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five blank term cards in a row, each with a small chart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 记住五个术语，分清可燃和易燃。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起贴好标签的瓶子，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a properly labeled bottle and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 先看标签再动手，下次见！
